category: Open-Source Headless Commerce, Composable Shopping APIs & Checkout Engines

repos.name: Medusa
repos.description: Modular headless commerce engine with multi-warehouse inventory, automated tax calculations, and customizable workflows
highlights: Modular architecture allowing granular overrides of cart, payment, pricing, and fulfillment modules
Next.js commerce storefront starter with sub-50ms TTFB and server-side rendering
Zero transaction percentage fees and 100% data sovereignty under permissive MIT license

repos.name: Saleor
repos.description: High-performance composable GraphQL headless commerce platform with multi-channel and multi-currency support
highlights: High-throughput GraphQL API designed for enterprise catalogs and omnichannel storefronts
Native multi-currency, multi-warehouse, and multi-channel internationalization out of the box
Event-driven webhook engine for asynchronous ERP, CRM, and fulfillment synchronizations

repos.name: Vendure
repos.description: Modern headless commerce framework built with TypeScript, NestJS, and GraphQL with plugin architecture
highlights: Clean architectural design built on NestJS and TypeORM with full TypeScript end-to-end typing
Extensible plugin system enabling custom business logic without forking core dependencies
Admin UI dashboard with asset management, order fulfillment, and promotions engine
